name: multi-reviewer
description: Multi-agent CROSS-VALIDATION protocol for already-drafted plans and already-written code. Does NOT generate plans or code itself; use superpowers for drafting, designing, and coding, then return here for review. Includes shared reviewer work-mode controls and conditional Java backend checks.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-validate plans and code with independent reviewers.
interface.longDescription: A review-only workflow for already-drafted product, technical, test, and rollout plans, plus post-coding QA regression. It coordinates one main implementer and N independent reviewers, enforces double-blind review discipline, and keeps coding ownership with the main agent.
defaultPrompt: Use mrcc to review this finalized plan.
Use mrcc to run QA regression on these changes.
